en.headline: Ocean Park Halloween Fest returns from 5 September
en.dek: The park lists its 2026 Halloween Fest on the official programme, with haunted houses and an Under the Castle collaboration running into early November on designated dates.

zh.headline: 海洋公園萬聖節活動9月5日起舉行
zh.dek: 公園官方節目及門票頁列出2026年萬聖節活動，指定日期設鬼屋及《Under the Castle》合作體驗，活動描述為舉行至11月1日。

en.headline: Porsche on test plates catches fire on Tai Hang Road
en.dek: The driver stopped and left the car after smoke rose from the rear near Tiger Balm Garden; firefighters put out the blaze and nobody was hurt.

zh.headline: 大坑道T牌保時捷行駛中起火 無人受傷
zh.dek: 一輛掛紅色試車牌的保時捷週日早上在大坑道近虎豹別墅車尾冒煙起火，司機停車逃生，消防救熄，無人受傷。

en.headline: Tin Shui Wai man arrested after early-morning public fight
en.dek: Police said a 32-year-old man was taken to hospital unconscious after a clash near a Tin Heng Estate playground, then arrested on suspicion of fighting in a public place.

zh.headline: 天水圍天恒邭凌晨鬥鬥 32歲男昏迷送院後被捕
zh.dek: 警方接報一名男子在天恒邭遊樂場附近遭至少四名男子圍毆，頭部受傷昏迷送院，其後涉嫌在公眾地方鬥鬥被捕。

en.headline: Observatory issues Thunderstorm Warning until 11.30am
en.dek: Isolated thunderstorms are expected over Hong Kong's eastern waters after the warning was issued at 9.40am, the Hong Kong Observatory said.

zh.headline: 天文台發出雷暴警告 有效至上午11時半
zh.dek: 天文台上午9時40分發出雷暴警告，預料本港東部水域有局部地區雷暴，警告有效至上午11時30分。

en.headline: Harbour City Toy Story carnival enters its last two days
en.dek: FOREVER TOYS at the Tsim Sha Tsui complex, built around Toy Story 5, is scheduled to end on Monday after a summer run that began in June.

zh.headline: 海港城《反斗奇兵》嘉年華進入最後兩日
zh.dek: 以《反斗奇兵5》為題的FOREVER TOYS活動由6月舉行至周一結束，海運大廈及港威商場仍設打卡裝置及主題店。

en.headline: Motorist stops missing six-year-old boy outside Yuen Long Plaza
en.dek: Police said a passer-by reported the child wandering near Castle Peak Road on Saturday afternoon; he was unhurt and returned to his mother.

zh.headline: 元朗廣場外發現報失六歲男童 途人報案助團聚
zh.dek: 警方指周六下午有途人在青山公路元朗段近元朗廣場發現男童獨自徘徊，事主沒有受傷，其後交還45歲母親照顧。

en.headline: Three private cars collide on Cheung Tsing Highway; nobody hurt
en.dek: The three vehicles piled up near the airport spur on Saturday night and stopped in the fast lane; all three male drivers passed breath tests, police said.

zh.headline: 長青公路三私家車串燒相撞 無人受傷
zh.dek: 三車周六晚近十時在往新界方向近機場支路相撞後停在快線，三名男司機通過酒精呼氣測試，警方正調查起因。

en.headline: Chiikawa-themed Light Rail makes its last weekend trips today
en.dek: Special trains have run four trips each Saturday and Sunday from Siu Hong since 25 July; an $88 same-day Light Rail pass is sold at that stop.

zh.headline: Chiikawa主題輕鐵今日最後一個周末行走
zh.dek: 由7月25日起逢周六日由兆康開出四班特色列車，當日於該站可買88元全日輕鐵乘車證。

en.headline: Discovery Bay stages fourth open-water swim challenge today
en.dek: Solo races of 400 metres, 1.7 kilometres and 3.8 kilometres, plus a 400-metre relay, finish at Tai Pak Beach on Sunday.

zh.headline: 第四屆愉景灣公開水域泳賽今日舉行
zh.dek: 公開組設400米、1.7公里及3.8公里個人賽，另有400米接力，終點同為大白灣泳灘。

en.headline: Driver missing after private car hits railings in Sau Mau Ping
en.dek: Police found an empty white private car with a damaged front end at On Sau Road and On Kin Road shortly after 5am and are trying to contact the owner.

zh.headline: 秀茂坪私家車撞欄司機不知所終
zh.dek: 周日清晨一輛白色私家車在安秀道轉入安健道時撞向路中鐵欄，警員到場發現車內無人，正聯絡車主。

en.headline: Fairview Park house burgled; jewellery worth about $300,000 taken
en.dek: A 49-year-old man reported two rings and a jade bracelet missing from a detached house on Bauhinia South Road late on Saturday; police classified the case as burglary.

zh.headline: 元朗錦緣花園獨立屋遇竊 失約30萬元戒指玉鑛
zh.dek: 一名49歲男子周六深夜報稱紫荊南路獨立屋失竊，警方初步點算兩隻戒指及一隻玉鑛失蹤，暫未有人被捕。

en.headline: Hong Kong Fashion Fest returns from 1 to 14 September
en.dek: The government-backed third edition will stage eight flagship programmes across the city, with public exhibitions free of charge.

zh.headline: 第三屆香港時裝蕃九月1日至14日舉行
zh.dek: 政府主辦的時裝蕃將推出八大旗艦節目，公眾展覽免費入場，涉及西九、會展及市區快閃店。

en.headline: MTR halts Tung Chung East works after new brick wall toppled
en.dek: A worker pushing a loaded pallet jack knocked down a wall started that afternoon, sending bricks to a lower floor; nobody was hurt, the corporation said.

zh.headline: 東涌東站磚牆被喊車撞倒 港鐵暫停涉事範圍工程
zh.dek: 港鐵表示，承建商指星期六下午4時許工人推載料喊車時疑撞倒剛開始硬建的磚牆，部分磚頭掉至下層，事件無人受傷。

en.headline: CFS recalls Taiwan rice noodles after trace formaldehyde found
en.dek: A Hsin Tung Yang sample bought from an online shop contained 12 parts per million of formaldehyde, the Centre for Food Safety said.

zh.headline: 台灣新東陽新竹米粉驗出微量甲醛 食安中心召回
zh.dek: 食物安全中心表示，網店抽查的新東陽新竹米粉樣本含百萬分之十二甲醛，已指示分銷商停售及回收受影響批次。

en.headline: Tai Po Baptist Public School opens new Fu Shin Estate campus
en.dek: Nearly 600 pupils displaced after the Wang Fuk Court fire reunite at renovated premises after months at two temporary sites; Education Secretary Christine Choi officiated at the opening.

zh.headline: 大埔浸信會公立學校富善邨新校舍啟用
zh.dek: 宏福苑火災後近600名師生分散兩處臨時校舍數月，周六於富善邨新校舍重聚，教育局局長蔡若蓮主持開幕。

en.headline: AFCD launches special dog-control patrols with immediate enforcement
en.dek: Special inspections begin today and continue on 5 and 6 September at places where dogs gather; owners who fail to keep dogs properly controlled will face action without prior warning.

zh.headline: 漁護署今起特別巡查狗隻控制 違例即時執法不預警
zh.dek: 署方今日及9月5、6日在全港多個狗隻聚集地點加強巡查，若發現畜養人未妥善控制狗隻將即時執法，不會事先警告。

en.headline: Diocesan Boys’ School to offer three university pathways from 2027
en.dek: The elite Direct Subsidy Scheme school plans to add the International Advanced Level curriculum alongside the DSE and IB Diploma, pending Education Bureau approval.

zh.headline: 拔萃男書院擬2027年起開辦三條升學路徑
zh.dek: 直資名校計劃新增國際高級程度會考課程，與文憑試及國際文憑並行，成為本港首間提供三條升學途徑的學校，尚待教育局批准。

en.headline: Man arrested after laundry pods dumped in Kam Ying Court turtle pond
en.dek: Police detained a 42-year-old man on suspicion of cruelty to animals after chemical laundry pods caused one fish to die and injured more than 30 turtles at the Ma On Shan estate.

zh.headline: 錦英苑龜池遭投洗衣球 警拘42歲男涉殘酷對待動物
zh.dek: 馬鞍山錦英苑二期水池周三發現大量泡沫，一魚死亡、逾30隻龜灼傷，沙田警區刑事調查隊周五以涉嫌殘酷對待動物拘捕一名42歲男子。

en.headline: City Chamber Orchestra stages Space Fantasy family shows this weekend
en.dek: Three English-language performances run at Tsuen Wan Town Hall on Saturday and Sunday, combining live music, dance, theatre and circus for ages three and up.

zh.headline: 城市室樂團《太空幻遊》本周末荃灣大會堂上演
zh.dek: 周六下午3時及晚上7時半、周日下午3時於荃灣大會堂演奏廳演出，英語家庭節目，門票120元起。

en.headline: CHP investigates new local Mpox case involving 39-year-old man
en.dek: The patient is stable and will continue isolation at Princess Margaret Hospital; high-risk groups are urged to get vaccinated.

zh.headline: 衞生防護中心調查39歲男子猴痘確診個案
zh.dek: 患者情況穩定，將轉送瑪嘉烈醫院繼續隔離治療；中心呼籲高風險群組接種疫苗。

en.headline: Hong Kong earmarks HK$50 million for Nepal-Tibet mudslide victims
en.dek: Chief Executive John Lee said the Disaster Relief Fund Advisory Committee will handle applications swiftly after deadly flash floods along the Himalayan border.

zh.headline: 李家超：賑災基金預留5,000萬元支援尼中泥石流災區
zh.dek: 行政長官對遇難者表示沉痛哀悼，賑災基金諮詢委員會將迅速處理撥款申請。

en.headline: Huanggang Port 20,000-person drill runs smoothly, ID or home-return permit accepted
en.dek: Security Secretary Chris Tang said the final large-scale pressure test with Shenzhen went as planned and opening timing will be decided jointly once conditions are met.

zh.headline: 皇崗口岸兩萬人演練大致暢順 開通後可用身分證或回鄉證
zh.dek: 保安局局長鄧炳強表示今次為開通前最後一次大型動員演練，整體暢順有序，正式通關時間將與深方協商決定。

en.headline: San Tin Tech City land prices ‘negotiable’, chairman seeks chip and drone firms
en.dek: Sunny Chai said the 210-hectare site will focus on mid- and downstream advanced manufacturing and that the company has already approached one or two leading enterprises.

zh.headline: 查毅超：新田科技城地價有得傾 已接觸一兩間龍頭企業
zh.dek: 新田科技城公司主席指園區集中中下游先進製造，冀吸引芯片、無人機及新能源車等高新產業落戶。

en.headline: Hospital Authority clarifies $250 diabetes fee is for personalised treatment
en.dek: The authority said the charge is not an admission fee for a talk but covers clinical assessment, personalised dietary advice and follow-up under the gazetted fee schedule.

zh.headline: 醫管局澄清糖尿病250元屬個人化治療收費 非講座入場費
zh.dek: 局方指收費按政府憲報標準，涵蓋臨床評估、個人化飲食建議及跟進，絕大部分一般健康教育講座均免費。

en.headline: Education chief says textbook prices up 3.6 per cent, rejects universal grant
en.dek: Christine Choi said the bureau is monitoring costs and has told publishers to avoid excessive packaging, while targeted subsidies remain available for low-income families.

zh.headline: 蔡若蓮：教科書價升3.6% 關注價格問題 拒恢復通派津貼
zh.dek: 教育局局長表示局方密切監察書價，已要求出版商避免過度精美印刷，基層家庭繼續獲書簿津貼。

en.headline: Palace Museum Egypt exhibition closes on Monday
en.dek: Ancient Egypt Unveiled at the Hong Kong Palace Museum ends on 31 August after a nine-and-a-half-month run in West Kowloon.

zh.headline: 香港故宮古埃及展周一結束
zh.dek: 香港故宮文化博物館「古埃及文明大展──埃及博物館珍藏」將於8月31日結束，西九展覽已舉行約九個半月。

en.headline: Fosun files Hong Kong listing for Club Med lifestyle group
en.dek: The mainland owner of Club Med said its ClubMed Lifestyle Group has applied to list on the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Main Board.

zh.headline: 復星為Club Med生活集團申請在港上市
zh.dek: 復星國際公布，旗下ClubMed Lifestyle Group已向香港聯交所提交主板獨立上市申請。

en.headline: Ride-hailing platform licence applications open until 30 October
en.dek: The Transport Department is inviting platform companies to apply for licences, while the transport minister said approvals will be decided on merit and not by a set number of operators.

zh.headline: 網約車平台牌照開放申請 截止10月30日
zh.dek: 運輸署邀請平台公司申請網約車服務牌照，運輸及物流局局長陳美寶表示會擇優而取，暫不預測會批出多少個牌照。

en.headline: Labour Department issues Amber Heat Stress at Work Warning
en.dek: The Labour Department said some workplaces face fairly high heat stress after issuing an Amber warning at 9.50am, and told employers to take heat-stroke precautions.

zh.headline: 勞工處發出黃色工作暑熱警告
zh.dek: 勞工處今早時9時50分發出黃色工作暑熱警告，指部分工作環境熱壓力頗高，提醒僱主及僱員採取防暑措施。

en.headline: DoJ welcomes NPCSC amendments regularising GBA lawyers scheme
en.dek: Amendments to the mainland Lawyers Law take effect on 1 September, giving dual-qualified Hong Kong lawyers a statutory basis to practise specified matters in nine Guangdong cities.

zh.headline: 律政司歡迎全國人大常委會修訂律師法 規範大灣區律師機制
zh.dek: 內地《律師法》修訂將於9月1日生效，為具備雙重資格的香港律師在廣東九市執業指定民商事法律事務提供法律依據。

en.headline: Tin Sum police station to become reporting centre from Sunday
en.dek: After the Tin Sum Division is merged into Sha Tin and Ma On Shan divisions, the Hin Keng Street report room will operate as a reporting centre from 8am to 10.30pm daily.

zh.headline: 田心警署周日改為報案中心 服務至晚上10時半
zh.dek: 沙田警區田心分區周日併入沙田及馬鞍山分區後，顯徑街報案室將改為報案中心，每日上午8時至晚上10時半開放。

en.headline: Observatory issues Very Hot Weather Warning on Saturday morning
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the warning at 8.40am, expecting very hot weather today with a high of about 33 degrees and brief sunshine after early showers.

zh.headline: 天文台周六早上發出酷熱天氣警告
zh.dek: 天文台今早8時40分發出酷熱天氣警告，預料今日酷熱，最高氣溫約33度，早上有驟雨後日間短暫有陽光。

en.headline: LCSD dance bills by local choreographers go on sale 1 September
en.dek: Three new works by Kaki Lee, Ching Chu and Rosalie Ng will play in Kwai Tsing and Tai Po this autumn and winter under the Hong Kong Artists Series 2026.

zh.headline: 康文署香港藝術家系列三齣新舞作 9月1日開售
zh.dek: 李嘉禊、朱晴及伍家蔚新作將於今秋至冬季在葵青劇院及大埔文娛中心黑盒劇場上演，早鳥優惠至9月14日。

en.headline: Government tenders Jardine's Lookout site for EV fast charging
en.dek: Inland Lot No. 9105 at 137 Tai Hang Road, covering 901.3 square metres, is being sold for conversion into an electric-vehicle fast charging station, with tenders closing on 6 November.

zh.headline: 政府招標出售渣甸山地皮作電動車高速充電站
zh.dek: 大坑道137號內地段第9105號面積901.3平方米，指定改作電動車高速充電站，公開招標於11月6日截標。

en.headline: Healthcare centre launches online medical dispute platform
en.dek: The Healthcare Dispute Resolution Centre opened a virtual and in-person mediation and arbitration service on Friday for patients and providers in Hong Kong and the Greater Bay Area.

zh.headline: 醫療爭議解決中心推出網上調解平台
zh.dek: 非牟利機構周五啟用網上及面對面調解與仲裁服務，供本港及大灣區患者與醫療服務提供者處理爭議。

en.headline: EDB opens Primary One 2027 applications from mid-September
en.dek: Hong Kong children born on or before 31 December 2021 can join the Primary One Admission System for September 2027, with digital applications encouraged through the ePOA platform.

zh.headline: 教育局公布2027年小一入學安排 9月中起接受申請
zh.dek: 2021年12月31日或之前出生、未曾入讀小學亦未獲派小一學位的本港兒童，可參加2027年9月小一入學統籌辦法，當局鼓勵經電子平台申請。

en.headline: Sui and Tang attire exhibition opens at Central Library
en.dek: Free show at Hong Kong Central Library runs until 6 September, blending reconstructed historical clothing with contemporary fashion and digital displays.

zh.headline: 隋唐服飾展於中央圖書館舉行 免費入場至9月6日
zh.dek: 中國文化節活動於香港中央圖書館展覽廊展出復原古裝、當代時裝及數碼展示，融合歷史與現代設計。

en.headline: Maxim’s Palace opens seventh branch at MOKO in Mong Kok
en.dek: The new outlet keeps traditional hand-pushed dim sum carts while adding live suckling-pig carving, a dim sum academy and an open-kitchen concept.

zh.headline: 美心皇宮旺角MOKO開第七分店 保留手推點心車
zh.dek: 新店保留傳統手推點心車，並加入即場燒乳豬、點心學院及開放式廚房元素。

en.headline: Pilotless eVTOL completes maiden Hong Kong flight at Cyberport
en.dek: EHang’s EH216-S, carrying a robot, flew a preset route at the Cyberport waterfront vertiport as part of the government’s low-altitude economy regulatory sandbox trials.

zh.headline: 無人駕駛eVTOL於數碼港完成香港首航試飛
zh.dek: 億航EH216-S搭載機械人在數碼港海濱垂直起降機場完成預設航線飛行，屬政府低空經濟監管沙盒X首批試點。

en.headline: MTR to use world-first skidding method for Hung Shui Kiu Station
en.dek: Two 10,000-tonne station structures will be built beside the Tuen Ma Line viaduct and slid into place next year, limiting service disruption to at most two days each time.

zh.headline: 港鐵洪水橋站全球首用「滑移施工」 明年兩次短暫影響屯馬綫
zh.dek: 兩座各重約1萬噸的車站結構將在屯馬綫高架橋旁預製，明年分兩次滑移就位，每次服務受影響不多於兩日。

en.headline: Over 96 per cent of Wang Fuk Court owners accept government buyout
en.dek: Housing secretary Winnie Ho said 1,914 households had accepted the offer as of Thursday, with only about 70 still outstanding before the 31 August deadline.

zh.headline: 宏福苑逾96%業主接受政府收購 尚餘約70戶未回覆
zh.dek: 房屋局局長何永賢表示，截至周四有1,914戶業主接受收購，距離8月31日截止期限尚餘約70戶。

en.headline: Police arrest 15 over insurance licence exam cheating scheme
en.dek: Commercial Crime Bureau officers detained six men and nine women during a test at a Kwun Tong centre; the Insurance Authority has suspended recognition of the FLMI qualification.

zh.headline: 保險牌照考試作弊案拘15人 監管局暫停承認相關資歷
zh.dek: 商業罪案調查科在觀塘試場突擊行動拘捕六男九女，保險業監管局即時暫停承認FLMI資歷。

en.headline: Elderly woman dies after being struck by garbage truck in Kwai Chung
en.dek: An 80-year-old pedestrian pulling a handcart was hit on Hing Ning Road near Kwai Tsing Theatre this morning; the South Asian driver was arrested on suspicion of dangerous driving causing death.

zh.headline: 葵涌垃圾車撞斃八旬女途人 司機涉危駕被捕
zh.dek: 今早約10時10分興寧路近葵青劇院對開，垃圾車撞倒拉手推車過路的八旬婦，事主當場不治，南亞裔司機涉危險駕駛導致他人死亡被捕。

en.headline: Customs seize 53.9 kg of suspected cocaine worth HK$36.2 million in Mong Kok
en.dek: A 49-year-old foreign man was arrested after officers found 11 kg in his backpack outside a Central hotel and a further 42.9 kg at a residential unit in Mong Kok.

zh.headline: 海關旺角搗毒品倉檢53.9公斤可卡因 拘外籍男
zh.dek: 49歲外籍男子在中環酒店外被截查，背囊藏11公斤懷疑可卡因，旺角住宅再起獲42.9公斤，市值約3,620萬元。

en.headline: Transport Department opens ride-hailing platform licence applications
en.dek: Interested platform companies can apply from today until 30 October for five-year licences under the new regulatory regime, with capital and operating-scale thresholds set.

zh.headline: 運輸署今起接受網約車平台牌照申請
zh.dek: 有意營運網約車平台的公司可由今日起至10月30日中午申請最長五年牌照，須符合資本及營運規模門檻。

en.headline: Retiree living costs rise three times faster than city inflation
en.dek: A new Hong Kong-Macau index from financial planners and a trustee put average monthly spending at HK$15,090, with travel and cross-boundary trips a main driver.

zh.headline: 退休開支指數升幅近通脹三倍 月均開支約1.5萬
zh.dek: 財務策劃師學會聯同萬通信託公布首個港澳退休開支指數，指平均每月開支約15,090元，旅遊及跨境行程是主要動力之一。

en.headline: Government to add four AI tools to 1823 hotline this year
en.dek: The Digital Policy Office said new systems would transcribe calls, extract email details and flag priority cases, cutting some triage times from two days to hours.

zh.headline: 數字辦今年推四項AI工具加強1823熱線
zh.dek: 數字政策辦公室表示，新系統將把來電轉文字、自動擷取電郵資料及識別優先個案，急案分流可由約兩天縮至數小時。

en.headline: HKEX studies merging GEM with Main Board under new chapter
en.dek: A source told the South China Morning Post the exchange is examining a Chapter 18D listing rule that would absorb more than 300 GEM companies, with public consultation possible by year-end.

zh.headline: 港交所據報研究GEM併入主板 擬增設18D章
zh.dek: 南華早報引述消息人士指，交易所正研究在《上市規則》新增第18D章，把逾300家GEM公司納入主板專章，或於年底諮詢公眾。

en.headline: HKU and prisons find hepatitis C in 4.1 per cent of inmates screened
en.dek: A voluntary pilot at Stanley Prison with the Correctional Services Department reported a rate far above the 0.3 per cent in the general population; treated inmates cleared the virus.

zh.headline: 港大懲教署篩查顯示在囚人士丙肝盛行率4.1%
zh.dek: 赤柱監獄自願先導計劃發現比率遠高於本港一般人口的0.3%，確診者經治療後病毒均被清除，團隊促擴展計劃。

en.headline: AFCD orders neutering after Stanley cafe dog complaint
en.dek: Officers took a 10-year-old dog for inspection after a report of a suspected fighting breed at a Stanley eatery; the owner arranged emergency surgery to avoid impoundment.

zh.headline: 漁護署赤柱食肄接投訴 要求狗主為十歲犬絕育
zh.dek: 署方周三接報巡查懷疑格鬥犬後將犬隻帶走調查，表明若不由註冊獸醫絕育便會扣押，狗主其後安排緊急手術。

en.headline: Regulators pick 36 use cases for first GenAI Sandbox++ cohort
en.dek: The HKMA, SFC, Insurance Authority and MPFA, with Cyberport, selected projects from nearly 100 proposals involving 30 financial institutions and 27 technology partners.

zh.headline: 金管局等公布首期GenAI沙盒++ 36個用例入選
zh.dek: 金管局、證監會、保監局及積金局聯同數碼港，從近100份建議中選出30家金融機構及27家技術夥伴的項目，稍後展開測試。

en.headline: CUHK president seeks larger loan for Northern Metropolis campus
en.dek: Dennis Lo Yuk-ming told RTHK he hopes the HK$10 billion construction loan reserved for universities in the Northern Metropolis can be increased so the university can plan a larger Hung Shui Kiu campus.

zh.headline: 中大校長盧煌明冀北都建校百億貸款加碼
zh.dek: 盧煌明接受港台訪問，指北部都會區洪水橋位置優越，希望政府將預留予院校的100億元建設貸款加碼，方便中大規劃擴展。

en.headline: CUHK chief seeks larger loan for Northern Metropolis campus
en.dek: Dennis Lo Yuk-ming said the government’s HK$10 billion construction loan for universities in the new town should be increased so the university can plan a larger campus.

zh.headline: 盧煌明冀北都大學城百億建設貸款加碼
zh.dek: 中大校長在港台節目表示，洪水橋位置優越，有助擴大學校規模，希望政府預留予院校的100億元貸款可以提高。

en.headline: Seven new members appointed to Transport Advisory Committee
en.dek: The Chief Executive reappointed two serving members and named seven new ones with effect from 1 October, two of them through the youth self-recommendation scheme.

zh.headline: 交諮會七名新成員獲委任 十月一日生效
zh.dek: 行政長官再委任兩名現任委員，並新委任七人，當中兩人經青年委員自薦計劃出任，任期由十月一日起。

en.headline: Regulators pick 36 agentic AI pilots for expanded finance sandbox
en.dek: HKMA, the SFC, the Insurance Authority and the MPFA selected 36 use cases from nearly 100 proposals, involving 30 financial institutions and 27 technology partners.

zh.headline: 金管局等公布首期GenA.I.沙盒++ 36個用例入選
zh.dek: 金管局、證監會、保監局及積金局聯同數碼港選出36個用例，來自近100份方案，涉及30家金融機構及27家技術夥伴。

en.headline: Yu Lan Cultural Festival returns to Victoria Park next weekend
en.dek: The ninth edition runs free from 4 to 6 September at Soccer Pitch 1, after the main Hungry Ghost Festival day on Thursday.

zh.headline: 第九屆盏蘭文化節下周末維園舉行 免費入場
zh.dek: 香港潮屬社團總會主辦活動於9月4日至6日在維園1號球場舉行，正日剛過，設搶孤及盆供比賽。

en.headline: Government to discuss new 10-year franchises with KMB and NLB
en.dek: New Lantao Bus’s current franchise expires on 1 March 2027 and Kowloon Motor Bus’s on 1 July 2027; the public may comment until 28 September.

zh.headline: 政府擬與九巴及嶼巴商討新十年專營權
zh.dek: 嶼巴現行專營權明年3月1日屆滿，九巴則於7月1日屆滿，兩巴已表明有意申請新專營權，公眾可於9月28日前發表意見。

en.headline: Two Kwun Tong flats burgled; 53-year-old man arrested nearby
en.dek: Police say three residents of Shun King Building on Ka Lok Street lost more than HK$47,000 after doors were forced on Thursday evening.

zh.headline: 觀塘順景大樓兩單位遇竊 警在附近拙53歲男
zh.dek: 嘉樂街順景大樓兩個單位周四晚被擠門搜掠，三名住戶合共損失逾4.7萬元，警方其後在約40米外大廈截獲一名男子。

en.headline: Ceiling and concrete fall at Wong Tai Sin bakery, woman hurt
en.dek: A section of ceiling about four metres by three metres came down at a ground-floor bakery on Sheung Fung Street this morning, hitting a customer who was taken to hospital.

zh.headline: 黃大仙麵包舖天花連石尾墮下 女顧客受傷送院
zh.dek: 雙鳳街一地下麵包舖今早約4米乘3米天花連同石尾剝落，擊中一名二十多歲女顧客，她清醒送院。

en.headline: Weekend outlook: showers and isolated storms, Sunday wetter
en.dek: The Observatory expects mainly cloudy skies with a few showers this weekend, very hot on Saturday and more thunderstorms in places on Sunday.

zh.headline: 周末天氣展望：有驟雨及局部雷暴 周日部分地區較多雨
zh.dek: 天文台預料本周末大致多雲，有幾陣驟雨及局部雷暴，周六日間酷熱，周日部分地區雨勢較多。

en.headline: Yan Ting opens two-night Coliseum run with The Alchemist Live
en.dek: Singer Yan Ting begins a two-night stand at Hong Kong Coliseum this evening, with a second show on Saturday, after tickets went on sale through Cityline and URBTIX.

zh.headline: 周殷廷紅館《The Alchemist Live》今晚揭幕
zh.dek: 歌手周殷廷今晚及周六連續兩場在紅磬香港體育館舉行演唱會，門票較早前經城市售票網及URBTIX發售。

en.headline: AIA Hong Kong suspends staff member after Kwun Tong mall fight
en.dek: The insurer said a related person has been temporarily suspended after a filmed dispute at apm in Kwun Tong in which three women were arrested.

zh.headline: 友邦香港就觀塚apm衝突暫停相關人士職務
zh.dek: 保險公司向傳媒表示，觀塚apm玩樂區衝突有相關人士已被暫時停任，公司會跟進；較早前有三名女子被捕。

en.headline: Police arrest 10 women in Tai Po, Sheung Shui and Fanling vice raids
en.dek: Tai Po officers and other departments searched four tenement subdivided flats on Thursday afternoon and arrested 10 mainland women on suspicion of breaching conditions of stay.

zh.headline: 大埔上水粉嶺掃黃 四劍房拙10名內地女子
zh.dek: 大埔警區聯同相關部門周四下午在四個唐樓劍房採取行動，拑10名內地女子，涉嫌違反逗留條件。

en.headline: Light goods van overturns after late-night crash with taxi in Sha Tin
en.dek: A light goods vehicle and a taxi collided at Tai Chung Kiu Road shortly after 11 p.m. on Thursday. Both drivers were injured and taken to Prince of Wales Hospital.

zh.headline: 沙田大涌橋路貨Van撞的士後翻側 兩司機受傷
zh.dek: 周四晚約11時18分，輕型貨車與的士在大涌橋路交界相撞，貨車翻側，兩名司機受傷送往威爾斯親王醫院。

en.headline: Empty red minibus overturns on Kwai Chung Road near Lai Chi Kok
en.dek: A driver-only public light bus struck a kerb and flipped onto Kwai Chung Road towards Tsuen Wan at 7.43 a.m., closing lanes near Mei Foo and sending the driver to hospital.

zh.headline: 葵涌道空載紅VAN撞壤翻側 往荃灣交通受阻
zh.dek: 今早7時43分一輛只有司機的紅色小巴在葵涌道近荔枝角公園失控撞壤翻側，司機面部受傷送院，美孚附近部分行車線封閉。

en.headline: Tourism Board to stage first international lantern show at Victoria Park
en.dek: The International Lantern Spectacular will run from 17 to 27 September beside the LCSD carnival, with displays lit from 6.30 p.m. and free admission.

zh.headline: 旅發局首辦國際中秋綵燈匯 9月17日起維園免費開放
zh.dek: 活動與康文署中秋綵燈會同期舉行，展出來自20個國家及地區的綵燈，每晚6時半亮燈。

en.headline: Loose dog runs from Tin Hau onto harbour bypass
en.dek: A two-year-old white mixed-breed escaped near the waterfront on Thursday afternoon and was later found with an injured front leg inside the Central–Wan Chai Bypass.

zh.headline: 北角海濱小狗失控竄入東廊及繞道 右前肢受傷被救回
zh.dek: 警方指外傭周四傍晚在天后海濱遛狗期間犬隻走失，跑入中環灣仔繞道，愛協其後發現右前肢受傷並聯絡狗主。

en.headline: Joint New Territories South raid arrests 29 over illegal work
en.dek: Officers from several police districts and other departments detained 22 men and seven women in Operation Champion on Thursday, including five mainland women suspected of prostitution.

zh.headline: 新界南跨部門反黑工拘29人 五內地女子涉賣淫
zh.dek: 警方聯同相關部門周四進行代號「冠軍」行動，突擊搜查新界南多個罪案黑點，拘捕22男7女。

en.headline: Coleman Wong qualifies again for US Open main draw
en.dek: The Hong Kong player beat Serbia’s Dusan Lajovic 6-4, 6-3 in the final qualifying round at Flushing Meadows on Thursday.

zh.headline: 黃澤林再闖美網正賽 決賽圈直落兩盤過關
zh.dek: 香港網球手周四在紐約資格賽決賽以6比4、6比3擊敗塞爾維亞的拉約維奇，連續第二年打入美網男單正賽。

en.headline: Hong Kong arts figures pay tribute to Yayoi Kusama after death at 97
en.dek: West Kowloon Cultural District Authority board chairman Bernard Chan and local design studio AllRightsReserved were among those expressing sadness following confirmation of the Japanese artist’s death.

zh.headline: 香港藝文界悼念草間彌生辭世 西九主席陳智思感懷
zh.dek: 西九文化區管理局董事局主席陳智思及本地設計工作室AllRightsReserved等周四就日本前衛藝術家草間彌生辭世表達哀思。

en.headline: Thunderstorm Warning extended to 4:30 a.m.; heavy rain hits Tai Po
en.dek: The Observatory also issued a Localised Heavy Rain Advisory for Tai Po and a Special Landslip Advisory for Po Toi Island and Sai Kung East as thundery showers affected the territory.

zh.headline: 雷暴警告延長至清晨4時30分 大埔錄得大雨
zh.dek: 天文台同時發出大埔區局部地區大雨提示，以及蒲台島及西貢東特別山泥傾瀉提示，雷雨區正影響本港。

en.headline: HKPC launches AI for All programme with free training for SMEs
en.dek: The Productivity Council opened the final segment of the government’s HK$50 million inclusive AI initiative on Thursday, focusing on practical skills for small firms.

zh.headline: 生產力局啟動全民AI普惠計劃 為中小企提供免費培訓
zh.dek: 香港生產力促進局周四啟動政府5,000萬港元「全民AI」普惠計劃的企業賦能部分，聚焦中小企實務應用培訓。

en.headline: Post Malone postpones September Hong Kong concert at Kai Tak Stadium
en.dek: Live Nation Hong Kong said the 16 September show has been postponed with full refunds for tickets bought through official platforms; no new date was given.

zh.headline: Post Malone啟德體育館演唱會延期 主辦方安排全額退款
zh.dek: Live Nation Hong Kong周四宣布原定9月16日啟德體育館演唱會延期，經官方渠道購票的觀眾可獲全額退款，暫未公布新日期。

en.headline: Four residents colonised by CPE at Wan Chai nursing home
en.dek: The Centre for Health Protection is investigating a cluster of carbapenemase-producing Enterobacteriaceae at Green Mountain Home; infection-control lapses are suspected to have allowed spread within the facility.

zh.headline: 灣仔綠山居護老院四院友帶產碳青霉烯酶腸道桿菌
zh.dek: 衞生防護中心調查綠山居護老院產碳青霉烯酶腸道桿菌帶菌群組，四名73至90歲院友情況穩定，院舍未妥善執行感染控制措施。

en.headline: Police officer charged with misconduct over indecent messages to suspect’s friend
en.dek: A 32-year-old officer from Kwai Tsing district is accused of privately contacting a female friend of a man arrested in a 2025 criminal case and sending her indecent texts and photos; he appears in court on Friday.

zh.headline: 男警涉向疑犯女友人傳不雅短訊及照片 被控公職人員行為失當
zh.dek: 32歲葵青警區男警被指在調查2025年刑事案件期間私下聯絡被捕人的女性朋友並傳送不雅內容，明日於沙田裁判法院提堂，已被停職。

en.headline: West Kowloon traffic police arrest two in illegal hire-car sting
en.dek: Undercover officers posing as passengers booked two private cars via online platforms; both drivers face charges of using vehicles for hire without a permit and without third-party insurance.

zh.headline: 西九龍交警放蛇打擊白牌車 兩本地司機被捕
zh.dek: 人員喬裝乘客透過網上平台租用兩輛私家車，因車輛沒有有效出租汽車許可證，拘捕兩名46歲及43歲本地男司機，兩人獲准保釋候查。

en.headline: Transport Advisory Committee discusses Star Ferry fare increase application
en.dek: Members balanced the operator’s financial viability against public acceptability for proposed rises of about 30 per cent on the two franchised cross-harbour routes.

zh.headline: 交諮會討論天星小輪兩航線加價申請 將向政府提交建議
zh.dek: 委員已平衡渡輪服務長遠財務可行性與公眾對擬議約三成加幅的接受程度，稍後提交建議供行政會議考慮。

en.headline: Labour Department lowers thresholds for heat stress at work warnings from Friday
en.dek: Two new trigger conditions will allow higher-level alerts to be issued more readily when temperatures reach extreme levels or an extreme heat special alert is in force.

zh.headline: 勞工處明日起優化工作暑熱警告 下調門檻及自動調高一級
zh.dek: 新增兩項觸發條件，當天文台發極端酷熱特別提示或全港多處氣溫達35度或以上時，可更早發出更高級別警告。

en.headline: Fisherman dies after suspected lightning strike on sampan off Tseung Kwan O
en.dek: A 67-year-old man was found unconscious on a sampan near the Cross Bay Link during the red rainstorm warning and was certified dead at Tseung Kwan O Hospital.

zh.headline: 將軍澳六旬漁民疑遭雷擊 舢舨上昏迷送院不治
zh.dek: 紅雨期間一名67歲男子在跨灣大橋對開海面舢舨上暈倒，送將軍澳醫院後證實死亡，初步懷疑遭雷電擊中。

en.headline: Privacy watchdog arrests 29-year-old man over alleged doxxing after boxing match
en.dek: The Office of the Privacy Commissioner for Personal Data said the Chinese national was detained in Kowloon today and granted bail pending further investigation.

zh.headline: 私隱專員公署拘29歲男 涉拳賽後「起底」對手
zh.dek: 公署今日在九龍區拘捕一名中國籍男子，涉嫌未經同意披露個人資料，已准保釋繼續調查。

en.headline: Thunderstorm Warning extended until 2:30 p.m.
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory extended the warning at noon, expecting isolated thunderstorms over the territory this afternoon.

zh.headline: 雷暴警告延長至下午2時30分
zh.dek: 天文台中午延長警告，預料本港今午有局部地區雷暴。

en.headline: City Chamber Orchestra premieres Space Fantasy in Tsuen Wan this weekend
en.dek: Three English-language family performances run on Saturday and Sunday at Tsuen Wan Town Hall Auditorium, with tickets from HK$120 at URBTIX.

zh.headline: 城市室樂團《太空幻遊》本周末荃灣大會堂首演
zh.dek: 周六下午3時及晚上7時半、周日下午3時於荃灣大會堂演奏廳演出，英語家庭節目，門票120至600元於城市售票網發售。
